data.name: CountdownWhat
data.comment: {0} is the kind of capture, such as Open menu: "Open menu in 3"

data.name: NothingCapturedYet
data.value: Nothing has been captured yet. Take a capture first; this repeats it.

data.name: LastWindowClosed
data.value: The window of the last capture ({0}) isn't open any more. Capture another window first.

data.name: LastAreaOffScreen
data.value: The area of the last capture isn't on any monitor now (the display layout changed). Take a new capture.

data.name: NoMenuWasOpen
data.value: No menu was open when the capture was taken. Open the menu during the countdown ({0} s; Settings › Capture › Delay per kind of capture).

data.name: NothingScrolled
data.value: Nothing scrolled, so only the visible part was captured.

data.name: StoppedAtHeightLimit
data.value: Stopped at the height limit ({0} px). It can be raised in Settings > Capture.

data.name: StoppedLostTrack
data.value: Stopped early at {0} px: the next part did not line up with the last (the page may change as it scrolls).

data.name: StoppedResized
data.value: Stopped at {0} px: the window changed size.

data.name: NoTextFound
data.value: No text was found in the selected area ({0}).

data.name: NoActiveWindow
data.value: There is no active window to capture. Click a window first.

data.name: NothingToDo
data.value: Nothing to do with the capture

data.name: SwitchOnStep
data.value: Switch on a step of the after-capture workflow (Settings › Output), such as "Open in the editor" or "Save to file".

data.name: PartBlack
data.value: Part of the capture is black

data.name: ScrollProgress_one
data.comment: {0}: pictures stitched so far; {1}: their height

data.name: ScrollProgress_other
data.comment: {0}: pictures stitched so far; {1}: their height

data.name: ScrollHint
data.value: It stops by itself at the bottom. Esc cancels; Finish now keeps what has been captured.

data.name: NothingToScroll
data.value: "{0}" has no area large enough to scroll.

data.name: UiAutomation
data.comment: Scrolling with {0}; a Windows technology's name

data.name: LinesAndLanguage_one
data.comment: under the copied text's start; {0}: lines; {1}: the OCR language

data.name: LinesAndLanguage_other
data.comment: under the copied text's start; {0}: lines; {1}: the OCR language

data.name: WindowNamesSeparator
data.comment: between window titles inside the quotes of CoreStrings.ProtectedInCapture/InRecording: "A", "B" / «A»، «B»

data.name: RegionSpoken
data.comment: what a screen reader says on the selection overlay: the size label, then the hint
